notes.title: Being a concubine wasn’t easy – Our true feelings from a thousand years ago, rev
notes.content:
Hello, we are the Trilogy of the Moon development team.

In this video, we would like to introduce you to what kind of game Trilogy of the Moon is and what its charms are from a more comfortable and closer perspective.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470356/5fb0f167eb6e9c599b4dd645a866f7df46acd988.png
This game is an interactive game based on a romantic fantasy story that spans between modern times and a thousand years ago, where you create the story yourself through live-action performances and various choices.

The mysterious yet romantic development involving Korea's top photographer "Ha Dong-hoon" and three concubine characters will offer you emotions beyond a simple game.

In this video, we will share behind-the-scenes stories from the production and introduce each character one by one, so we hope you enjoy it casually :)

Trilogy of the Moon is currently available to play on Steam, and you can enjoy the special experience of the story flowing according to your choices.
Now, please join us in listening to our story!
[previewyoutube=O_30H1m4KVs;full][/previewyoutube]
Additionally, Trilogy of the Moon shares the same universe with another title, Eternal Rebirth and their stories are interconnected.
By playing both games, you'll gain a deeper understanding of the complex relationships and events between characters, and enjoy the unique experience of comparing the two narratives from different perspectives.

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470356/22c51754706e2e9b1efd39de8b242ad32dc9ce6a.jpg

Hello from the  team.

We would like to inform you about our game's release schedule. 

Although we had been preparing for a March release, 
the STEAM build review process has taken longer than expected, 
forcing us to adjust our release date to April.

Currently, our team is focusing all our efforts on passing the review as quickly as possible, 
aiming for an early April release. We sincerely apologize for not being able to meet with our eager gamers sooner than planned.

We are also preparing various special events for the release and will share more news as soon as the review is completed. 

Press "Wishlist" on the "Trilogy of the Moon" store page to receive the latest release updates first!

We are committed to resolving this delay promptly and providing you with the best gaming experience possible.

We deeply appreciate everyone who continues to support us and patiently wait for our game's release.

Trilogy of the Moon Team

notes.title: The Steam official page for Trilogy of the Moon is now open!
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Trilogy of the Moon development team.

We're excited to announce that the Steam official page for Trilogy of the Moon is now live!

Our game is a unique romantic FMV game that transcends past and present, following the story of Ha Dong-hun, the reincarnation of King Ha-do-u IV of Baran, as he reunites with his three former consorts in the present day. Together, they begin an extraordinary journey of cohabitation filled with various episodes.

We are currently preparing a demo version of Trilogy of the Moon, and we look forward to sharing more exciting updates with you soon.

Also, we've launched our official YouTube channel, so please show us your support!
